{{Top|leg}}
'''Nuuk Kuur''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] contact and a farmer on the planet [[Kwevron]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he was discovered, along with fellow farmer [[Idu Taanfaar]], and captured by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under the command of [[Falto Dragen]], but was later freed by Alliance recruiter [[Cala Worner]] and a group of previously uncommitted bystanders.
